item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ATRANDOM
  • 発売日: 2009-10-25
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妻が妻でなくなる日
  • 英語名: Tsuma ga Tsuma de Nakunaru Hi

别名

  • The day when a wife fails to be a wife

あらすじ

“The first man who taught me the pleasure of being a woman was not my husband”

The housewife experiences sudden meeting - which let her fall into a sex slave.

View how she turn into a sex maniac from her husband’s perspective, and her own perspective!
